lines.text: Missiles are being fired at you, and a wooden house won't save you.
So you decide to hide underground.
But the earth alone would just cave in on you, so you build walls of reinforced concrete.
Now you have a safe, protected pit, but missiles can fall on you from above, so you build a roof.
But there's an alarm and no way in, so you build a door.
But a regular door can blow off from the blast wave.
That's why bunkers use special hatches that withstand enormous pressure!
But when everything is sealed, the air inside starts running out, because no fresh air gets in.
So you add an air vent with a valve that shuts by itself when the blast arrives.
But what if the house collapses and blocks your exit?
So you dig and build an emergency tunnel, ten meters long.
A bit of light, a bed, and congratulations, you built a bunker!
